scope: Final cross-platform calendar/summary/cost and native primitive diff group
reviewExtent: Full new helper bodies; complete tracked diffs for constants export, native Button/Card/VibeSelector/theme. Caller account isolation remains covered separately by list/store reviews.
invariants: Valid calendar dates and ordered ranges yield upcoming/in-progress/past independently of generation status
Web hydrates the server date snapshot then follows local midnight/focus; native follows midnight and foreground; timers/subscriptions cleaned up
Inclusive duration uses UTC calendar ordinals and avoids DST elapsed-time errors; invalid values have unavailable copy
Known costs require finite nonnegative amounts and currency codes; summaries separate currencies and per-person/category bases
Cached detail reuse requires same trip/revision and no refresh marker within caller account scope
Native primary action uses consistent darker palette; disabled vibe controls cannot mutate choices; trip card duration handles unknown and singular values

validation.scope: Two native date/cost suites and two web duration/calendar suites

limits: Diff review does not replace current-device accessibility acceptance or exact-candidate full checks
